messages:
Ivy (Marketing): Heads-up: aiming for soft launch Fri 2026-05-22 08:00 PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs anchor, and webinar RSVP (we'll do a short post-launch webinar at T+2 days). Can eng confirm canary plan and metrics?
Marcus (Eng): We can run a canary. Which model variant will we call out? We tested rwd-infer-v2-small-quant in staging. Any hard claims?
Ivy (Marketing): We'll avoid quantization claims publicly. Embargo lift = 2026-05-22 08:00 PT. Changelog draft PR: https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-478. Please add final one-liner + 2 bullets.
Ethan (Docs): I'll set up /docs/release-2026-05-22 and add anchor /docs/release-2026-05-22#notes. Will include a note about recommended routing flags. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Leah (Growth): RSVP (staging): https://events.redwood.ai/launch-may?utm_campaign=may_launch. I'll update once docs link available. Need 1-line speaker blurb and CTA.
Marcus (Eng): Perf: p50 81ms (was 100ms), p95 330ms (was 450ms). Token cost ~9% lower. CSV attached in PR. Can marketing use "~20%"?
Ivy (Marketing): We'll use: "~20% latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token cost" as conservative messaging. Need eng sign-off.
Marcus (Eng): OK with wording. Recommend staged rollout: 10% T+0, 40% T+30m, 100% T+2.5h. Ops please define rollback.
Sara (Ops): Rollback criteria: error rate >1% for 5m OR sustained p95 >3x baseline. We'll post metrics to #eng-sre and tag this thread if triggered.
Ivy (Marketing): Changelog line: "Routing optimizations and KV-cache fixes lower latency and reduce hosting costs." Blog bullets: "Smarter request routing reduces average token latency by ~20%" and "KV-cache fixes reduce cold-cache tail latency and compute spend."
Ethan (Docs): Adding migration note: "No changes required; routing flags optional for Dedicated customers." ETA docs up by EOD.
rollout-bot: Canary schedule: 10% -> 1768890599 (T+10m), 40% -> 1768892399 (T+40m), 100% -> 1768895999 (T+2.5h). Healthchecks configured. :robot_face:
Leah (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers to see a demo of faster inference and routing controls." CTA: "Register now 10 seats left."
Ivy (Marketing): Please include exact model name in docs blog (we'll say rwd-infer-v2-small-quant internally). Thanks all. Tagging @Marcus @Ethan @Sara.
